summary: This video previews Chinese server team setups and gear strategies for the upcoming Piece of Treasury crafting event. For Dauntless teams, prioritizing a Crit Damage piece is the safest bet across heroes like Guinavivre, Nastjenka, and Scaarr to stack target damage amplification bonuses. Corrosion teams featuring Szecedith, Rook, and Rhyviel follow similar gear building rules focused on Crit Rate, Crit Damage, and Skill Haste.
